scope: Reader evidence on 13 translations and the Listeria collection; one archive correction

reader_evidence.engagement_proxy: 90 seconds in a visible focused tab with content onscreen and at least 50% of content reached
reader_evidence.role: Optional self-report, not verified professional identity
reader_evidence.deduplication: Once per path per tab session; current page only if sessionStorage is unavailable
reader_evidence.reporting: Event hierarchy preserves content kind, article path, role and response; pre-instrumentation periods marked not_measured
reader_evidence.coverage_limit: Analytics blockers and unavailable storage affect coverage; engagement is not proof of comprehension or usefulness

archive_correction.verified_scope: Bibliographic metadata and publicly available poster abstract; not the full publication
changes: Removed unsupported regulatory and operational prescriptions
Preserved URL and original date; added correction note and updated date

validation.browser: Desktop and 390px mobile: foreground/hidden/focus timing, 90-second threshold, all response choices, keyboard, session reload, blocked storage, print, JavaScript disabled, download regression
